text: URGENT: Your bank account has been suspended. Verify immediately at http://secure-bank-update.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Creates urgency and directs the user to a suspicious verification link.
action: Do not click the link. Contact your bank through its official app or website.

text: Your account will be blocked today. Update your KYC now: http://kyc-update-secure.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Threatens account blocking and requests KYC through an unverified link.
action: Do not open the link. Verify KYC requests with the official institution.

text: Congratulations! You have won a reward. Claim now at http://claim-reward-now.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Uses an unexpected reward to encourage clicking a suspicious link.
action: Do not click the link or provide personal information.

text: Your password expires today. Reset immediately using http://secure-password-reset.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Creates urgency and directs the user to an unverified password reset page.
action: Use only the official website or app to change your password.

text: Dear customer, unusual activity detected. Secure your account here: http://account-security-alert.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Uses fear about account activity to push the user toward a suspicious link.
action: Do not click the link. Check account activity through the official app.

text: Your parcel is waiting. Pay a small delivery fee here: http://delivery-fee.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Requests payment through an unexpected delivery link.
action: Verify the delivery directly with the official courier.

text: Income tax refund approved. Submit bank details at http://tax-refund-claim.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Attempts to collect sensitive bank information using a fake refund claim.
action: Do not submit bank details. Use the official tax portal.

text: Your social media account will be deleted in 24 hours. Verify now: http://social-verify.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Threatens account deletion to force immediate action.
action: Open the official social media app instead of the link.

text: Security alert: confirm your card details at http://card-secure-check.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Attempts to steal payment card information.
action: Never provide card details through an unverified link.

text: Your subscription payment failed. Update payment details: http://payment-update.xyz
label: SCAM
explanation: Uses a payment problem to request sensitive information.
action: Verify billing information through the official service.
